title: Final inequality condition
description: Essential: The answer must state the inequality a >= (2 + μ1/μ2) * μ1 * g.

title: Acceleration on cloth
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify the disk's acceleration relative to the cloth as a1 = μ1 * g.

title: Deceleration on table
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify the disk's deceleration on the bare table as a2 = μ2 * g.

title: Kinematics on cloth
description: Important: The solution must relate the disk's displacement on the cloth (x1) and the cloth's displacement (x) using the geometry, such as x = l/2 + x1.

title: Stopping distance constraint
description: Important: The solution must apply the condition that the disk's stopping distance on the table (x2) satisfies x2 <= l/2 - x1.

title: Velocity relation
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly equate v^2 = 2 * a1 * x1 and v^2 = 2 * a2 * x2 to link the motions.

title: Time elimination
description: Optional: The solution may show eliminating time from kinematic equations for the cloth and disk motions.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the frictional force direction or the sign of acceleration/deceleration is incorrectly assigned.

title: Incorrect geometric limit
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the condition for not falling is incorrectly written (e.g., using l instead of l/2, or wrong inequality direction).
